name: a line of weeds growing along a crack with tiny wild flowers
label: wasteland_ruins/weeds-c
reasons: 화풍: 칸 정보량이 기준보다 훨씬 낮음 (4/4)

surfaces.part: line of weeds along a crack, drawn as a sparse diagonal scatter of green blades
tiny wild flowers (pink, yellow, white dots)

answer.evidence: The drawing is a sparse diagonal scatter of weed blades with a few flower pixels, running from the lower left (rows 11-14) up to the upper right (rows 1-5). It has no solid body, no front-edge line, no eave shadow and no ellipse. There is no vertical front face of 3 or more rows; the silhouette widths (0-8 px) show only a ground decal seen from above. This fits the flat kind, so it reads as top_down_slab.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a tiny diagonal sprite (about 20x20 px at 2x) on a dark transparent/grey background, far smaller than one 16x16 tile and nowhere near a 4x3-tile ground patch. The measured tone facts are 0 because the piece is smaller than a tile, so I judged by eye. It shows only about 3 shades of green plus a few flower dots, with 11 distinct colours in total, against 80 for the grass reference. It has no ground base, no soil or crack grain, and no tiling surface, so it does not read as a laid ground patch. Beodeul grass and paving refs fill full tiles with varied tufts and stone shading. Next to them the candidate looks thin and sticker-like, and its outline cannot be judged reliably at this size. Fails for the wrong kind and scale and for much lower density.
